newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end up as election campaign starts.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end up as election campaign starts.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended up on Monday as a smooth start of the campaign on Sunday for the May 29 general elections boosted sentiment, with the focus on newly-listed Multidana, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 4.05 points, or 0.62 percent, to close at 656.53 points. Advancers led decliners by 83 to 45 with 62 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 762 billion rupiah compared with 462 billion rupiah on Friday.
